name: add_item_to_cart
description: Adds or updates a product item in the authenticated user's cart on Carrefour France. Allows specifying the product EAN, desired quantity, the basket service (store/drive), and the sub-basket type (e.g. drive click-and-collect). Also accepts a tracking context to indicate the page type and ID from which the action was triggered. Returns updated cart totals and summary.

ean.description: The EAN (barcode) of the product to add or update in the cart.

counter.description: The desired quantity of the product to set in the cart.

basketServiceId.description: The basket service ID identifying the store or drive service to use for the cart.

subBasketType.description: The sub-basket type, e.g. 'drive_clcv' for drive click-and-collect.

pageType.description: The type of page from which the add-to-cart action is triggered, used for tracking (e.g. 'moncompte', 'search', 'productdetail', 'basket').

pageId.description: The page identifier used for tracking (e.g. 'moncompte', 'search', 'productdetail', 'basket').
